text:
The front door is poorly boarded shut, but it had a very big lock on it.
I won't get out without a key.
There is also some kind of mechanism barely visible in the right corner of the door.
It looks like a switch for something.
Someone carved an X into this door.
It lokds very worn out and dirty.

door_side@6,16.text: There is a bloody smear on it.
